section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Self-Attributed Need for Uniqueness Scale (Lynn & Harris, 1997), a 4-item measure used to assess participants' desire for uniqueness on a 5-point scale. The text notes that internal consistency reliability was adequate for both women (α = .75) and men (α = .73) in the current study, indicating satisfactory validity and reliability in previous research.
